This page is the audit trail for the strategy's methodology. Every parameter, threshold, and acceptance criterion was committed to version control in dated, immutable form **before** any out-of-sample backtest fired.

The full source-of-truth documents live in the repository root:

- `PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP.md` — 5-instrument iron condor cluster
- `PRE_COMMITMENT_WHEEL.md` — 9-name adaptive wheel
- `LITERATURE_FINDINGS.md` — per-paper methodology audit (8 papers)
- `LITERATURE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md` — identified gaps (ship-blocking vs ship-improving)
- `CAPSTONE_BACKLOG.md` — running task tracker

This page summarizes what's locked.

## VRP cluster (PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP.md) {#vrp}

### Universe (locked)

5 instruments: SPX, RUT, NDX, TLT, GLD. PEP is reserved for the wheel basket (locked there, not here).

### Entry construction

| Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Structure | Defined-risk iron condor (short put + short call, both protected) | — |
| Short put delta | −0.16 | One-sigma OTM via BS Greeks |
| Short call delta | +0.16 | Symmetric |
| Wing widths | 5/5/25/1/1 (SPX/RUT/NDX/TLT/GLD) | Match listed strike grid |
| DTE at entry | 30–45 calendar days, prefer 35 | Theta acceleration begins ~45 DTE; closing at 21 leaves high-decay window inside trade |
| Entry frequency | Weekly Monday open per instrument | Limits dependency between trades |

### Exit logic — five fates per side

Two `Trade` objects per iron condor, sharing `iron_condor_id`. Independent management.

| Fate | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `profit_target` | Per-side debit ≤ 50% of side's entry credit |
| `stop_loss` | Per-side debit ≥ 200% of side's entry credit (gap-aware fill) |
| `time_exit` | DTE ≤ 21 (per side) |
| `emergency` | \|short_delta\| > 0.50 |
| `eos_force` | End-of-OOS forced close |

### Halt framework — Layers 1, 4, 5 active

(See [Mechanics](mechanics.qmd) for layer-by-layer details.)

Layer 5 v2 was amended on 2026-05-03 — see §4.1 amendment in PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP.md (catch-22 documented and fixed). Layer 4 was amended 2026-05-03 to align implementation with spec text "in trailing 90 days" (bug-fix-of-implementation, not methodology amendment).

### ML stack — three calibrated heads

(See [Mechanics §ML stack](mechanics.qmd#ml-stack-3-calibrated-heads) for full pre-committed targets, sizing curves, acceptance criteria.)

### Capital allocation

- Per-instrument: equal-weight Phase B-1, quality-weighted Phase B-2
- Aggregate book scaler: `(1 − p_stress)` from Head 2

### Sample windows (locked)

- IS (training): 2012-03-26 → 2017-12-31
- OOS (reporting): 2018-01-01 → 2024-12-31
- Walk-forward refit cadence: annually

### Sensitivity grid (declared in advance)

| Dimension | Grid values | Count |
|---|---|---:|
| Short delta target | 0.10, 0.16, 0.25 | 3 |
| Spread width | 0.5×, 1.0×, 2.0× | 3 |
| DTE entry window | (25,40), (30,45), (35,50) | 3 |
| Profit target | 25%, 50%, 75% | 3 |
| Stop loss multiple | 1.5×, 2.0×, 3.0× | 3 |
| Time exit DTE | 14, 21, 28 | 3 |
| **Total** | | **3⁶ = 729** |

DSR uses N̂ from Eq. 9 of Bailey & López de Prado 2014 (correlation-adjusted), not raw 729.

### Acceptance gates

In order of evaluation:

1. SPX iron condor OOS Sharpe > 0.286 (v1.5 anchor) before multi-instrument
2. Aggregate 5-instrument Sharpe ≥ SPX-only (multi-instrument adds value)
3. Each ML head meets its acceptance criterion or is dropped per fallback
4. DSR (PSR threshold) ≥ 0.95 against N̂-trial benchmark
5. PBO via CSCV ≤ 0.30
6. Reproducibility test passes (seed=42, byte-identical equity curve)

## Wheel basket (PRE_COMMITMENT_WHEEL.md) {#wheel}

### Basket selection (locked)

- **Primary 9-name basket:** AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, JNJ, KO, PG, WMT, JPM, PEP
- **Robustness 7-name strict:** drops JPM, PEP
- **Robustness 8-name:** adds JPM only

### 5-layer wheel architecture

- **Layer 1** Regime-conditional delta: VIX bottom Q → 0.15, mid → 0.20, top → 0.25
- **Layer 2** Per-name vol-adjusted strikes: RV>35% widens delta by +0.05
- **Layer 3** Per-name 30-day RV forecaster: XGBoost on HAR-RV + exogenous, sizing = clip(target_rv/forecast, 0.4, 1.5), skip if forecast > 95th pctile
- **Layer 4** Earnings-aware management: 7-day blackout pre-earnings, narrow CCs
- **Layer 5** Fundamental-only defensive rolls: entry premise broken (EPS guidance cut >20%, dividend cut, 2-notch downgrade, sector underperformance + name residual return < −10%)

### Disclosed limitations (per §1.1, §2.1)

- 8 of 9 names pay dividends → American early-exercise risk on ITM puts (Merton Theorem 13). Pricing approximation: BS European-style for all wheel names; magnitude small at OTM entry, grows ITM near ex-dividend dates.
- HAR-RV forecaster uses daily-frequency RV components, not 5-minute intraday (per BTZ §3.2.1 caveat).

### Acceptance gates

1. 9-name primary Sharpe ≥ 7-name strict − 0.05 (else strict becomes headline)
2. Each ML/forecaster head meets criterion or falls back
3. DSR ≥ 0.95
4. PBO ≤ 0.30
5. Reproducibility test passes
6. Within-sector probe (KO/PEP correlation) reported regardless of pass/fail

## Literature foundation (LITERATURE_FINDINGS.md) {#literature}

8 papers read in full. Per-paper findings cataloged:

- **Bailey & López de Prado 2014** — Deflated Sharpe Ratio + Eq. 9 N̂ correction
- **Bailey/Borwein/López de Prado/Zhu 2015** — Probability of Backtest Overfitting via CSCV
- **Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana 2005** — Platt-vs-isotonic calibration sample-size threshold (~200)
- **Egger & Vestal 2025** — Hoeffding's inequality trader application; 50/25/10% threshold semantics
- **Carr & Wu 2003/2004** — Variance risk premia, evidence-base heterogeneity across instruments
- **Bollerslev/Tauchen/Zhou 2009** — Quarterly forecast horizon empirically optimal; Hodrick SE for overlapping regressions
- **Black & Scholes 1973** — BS empirical bias (overvalues high-var, undervalues low-var) is the source of VRP
- **Merton 1973** — American early-exercise on dividend-paying stocks; rational pricing bounds

## Methodology amendments after pre-commit

Two amendments have been logged with date, reason, and disclosure block:

- **§4.1 Layer 5 v2** (2026-05-03 morning) — Dropped condition 4 (DD-recovery) from auto_resume_ready, added 60-day time-fallback. Reason: catch-22 made halts latch permanently. Structurally broken design, not result-driven. Logged inline in §4.1.
- **Layer 4 implementation alignment** (2026-05-03 morning) — Switched `underwater_days` and `current_dd_frac` from all-time-HWM reference to trailing-90-day reference, matching §4 spec text "in trailing 90 days." Bug-fix-of-implementation, not methodology amendment. Logged in DIAGNOSIS_HALTS.md UPDATE 2.

The §4.1 acceptance text was further edited on 2026-05-03 to remove a Sharpe-band plausibility range (0.15–0.40) that was itself a form of post-hoc target-setting. Replaced with structural-only criteria. Logged inline in §4.1 with date and reason.
